![](images/14/14a67562652c609deeaf6b7606cee130685e2c2b5382f1a5436cd4e441591b94.png)

Which of the following could be the function that generates the vector field above?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Every arrow points downward. Its horizontal component points left for $x<0$, vanishes on the $y$-axis, and points right for $x>0$. These features match

$$
F(x,y)=xi-j=\langle x,-1\rangle.
$$

The constant vector fields would have the same direction everywhere, while $-xi+yj$ would point upward in the upper half-plane and inward horizontally.
